sql: SELECT s."Zip" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE f."District Name" = 'Fresno County Office of Education' AND f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1

SELECT s."MailStreet" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE f."FRPM Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT
  f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"
FROM california_schools."frpm" f
JOIN california_schools."schools" s
  ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE (s."EdOpsName" = 'Continuation School' OR f."Educational Option Type" = 'Continuation School')
  AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0
  AND f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" ASC
FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
SELECT MAX("Free Meal Count (K-12)" / "Enrollment (K-12)") FROM california_schools."frpm" WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda' AND "Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" t ON s."CDSCode" = t."cds" WHERE t."AvgScrMath" > 400 AND s."Virtual" = 'F'
SELECT s."School" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds" WHERE ss."NumTstTakr" > 500 AND s."Magnet" = 1

SELECT s."NumTstTakr"
FROM california_schools."satscores" s
JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."cds" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE f."FRPM Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s."Phone" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" sa ON s."CDSCode" = sa."cds" WHERE sa."NumGE1500" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sa."NumGE1500" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(t1."CDSCode") FROM california_schools."schools" t1 JOIN california_schools."satscores" t2 ON t1."CDSCode" = t2."cds" WHERE t1."FundingType" = 'Directly funded' AND t2."AvgScrMath" > 560

SELECT s."Phone" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND f."Charter Funding Type" = 'Directly funded' AND s."OpenDate" > '2000-01-01'

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" FROM california_schools."satscores" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."cds" = f."CDSCode" WHERE s."AvgScrRead" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s."AvgScrRead" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT sc."Phone" FROM california_schools."schools" sc JOIN california_schools."satscores" sa ON sc."CDSCode" = sa."cds" WHERE sa."NumTstTakr" > 0 AND sa."NumGE1500" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (sa."NumGE1500" / sa."NumTstTakr") DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

SELECT MAX(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)) FROM california_schools."frpm" f JOIN california_schools."satscores" s ON f."CDSCode" = s."cds" WHERE s."NumGE1500" / NULLIF(s."NumTstTakr", 0) > 0.3
SELECT "CDSCode" FROM california_schools."frpm" WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" + "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500

SELECT s."NCESSchool" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" sa ON s."CDSCode" = sa."cds" WHERE s."County" = 'Alameda' AND s."StatusType" = 'Merged' AND sa."NumTstTakr" < 100

SELECT s."District" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" sa ON s."CDSCode" = sa."cds" WHERE s."StatusType" = 'Active' AND sa."AvgScrRead" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s."District" ORDER BY AVG(sa."AvgScrRead") DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s."Phone" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" sat ON s."CDSCode" = sat."cds" WHERE sat."AvgScrMath" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sat."AvgScrMath" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s."CharterNum" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" sa ON s."CDSCode" = sa."cds" WHERE sa."AvgScrWrite" > 499 AND s."CharterNum" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sa."AvgScrWrite" DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" sat ON s."CDSCode" = sat."cds" WHERE s."City" = 'Fresno' AND s."FundingType" = 'Directly funded' AND sat."NumTstTakr" <= 250
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."frpm" WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."frpm" WHERE "County Name" = 'Amador' AND "Low Grade" = '9' AND "High Grade" = '12'

SELECT "sname"
FROM california_schools."satscores"
WHERE "cname" = 'Contra Costa' AND "sname" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "NumTstTakr" DESC NULLS LAST
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT s."School", s."Street" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30

SELECT T1."School", T1."FundingType" FROM california_schools."schools" T1 JOIN california_schools."satscores" T2 ON T1."CDSCode" = T2."cds" WHERE T1."City" = 'Riverside' GROUP BY T1."School", T1."FundingType" HAVING AVG(T2."AvgScrMath") > 400

SELECT s."School", s."Street", s."City", s."State", s."Zip" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE s."County" = 'Monterey' AND s."EILName" = 'High School' AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800

SELECT T1."School", T2."NumGE1500" FROM california_schools."schools" T1 JOIN california_schools."satscores" T2 ON T1."CDSCode" = T2."cds" JOIN california_schools."frpm" T3 ON T1."CDSCode" = T3."CDSCode" WHERE T3."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(T3."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) > 0.1

SELECT s."OpenDate"
FROM california_schools."schools" s
JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s."School", sa."AvgScrWrite", s."Phone" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" sa ON s."CDSCode" = sa."cds" WHERE SUBSTR(s."OpenDate", 1, 4) > '1991' OR (s."ClosedDate" IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(s."ClosedDate", 1, 4) < '2000')

SELECT s."City" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE s."City" IS NOT NULL AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s."City" ORDER BY SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT "Free Meal Count (K-12)" / "Enrollment (K-12)" FROM california_schools."frpm" WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST OFFSET 9 ROWS FETCH NEXT 2 ROWS ONLY

SELECT f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)"
FROM california_schools."frpm" f
JOIN california_schools."schools" s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE s.soc = '66'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST
FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT s."Website", s."School" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000

SELECT s."AdmEmail1" FROM california_schools."frpm" f JOIN california_schools."schools" s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode" WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s."School", s."DOCType" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM california_schools."schools" s2 JOIN california_schools."frpm" f2 ON s2."CDSCode" = f2."CDSCode" WHERE s2."FundingType" = 'Locally funded')

SELECT t2."Street", t2."City", t2."Zip", t2."State" FROM california_schools."satscores" t1 JOIN california_schools."schools" t2 ON t1."cds" = t2."CDSCode" WHERE t1."NumTstTakr" > 0 AND t1."NumGE1500" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t1."NumGE1500" / t1."NumTstTakr" ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" FROM california_schools."frpm" f JOIN california_schools."schools" s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode" WHERE s."AdmFName1" = 'Kacey'
SELECT s."Website" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" sa ON s."CDSCode" = sa."cds" WHERE s."County" = 'Los Angeles' AND sa."NumTstTakr" BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000

SELECT s."Phone" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" sa ON s."CDSCode" = sa."cds" WHERE s."District" = 'Fresno Unified' AND sa."AvgScrRead" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sa."AvgScrRead" ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT AVG(t."NumTstTakr") FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" t ON s."CDSCode" = t."cds" WHERE s."City" = 'Fresno' AND s."OpenDate" LIKE '1980%'

SELECT s."EdOpsCode" FROM california_schools."satscores" ss JOIN california_schools."schools" s ON ss."cds" = s."CDSCode" WHERE ss."AvgScrMath" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ss."AvgScrMath" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT sc."AdmFName1", sc."AdmLName1", sc."AdmFName2", sc."AdmLName2", sc."AdmFName3", sc."AdmLName3" FROM california_schools."satscores" s JOIN california_schools."schools" sc ON s."cds" = sc."CDSCode" WHERE s."NumGE1500" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s."NumGE1500" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT "School"
FROM (
  SELECT s."School",
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s."County" ORDER BY sa."AvgScrRead" DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk
  FROM california_schools."schools" s
  JOIN california_schools."satscores" sa
    ON s."CDSCode" = sa."cds"
  WHERE s."Virtual" = 'F' AND sa."AvgScrRead" IS NOT NULL
)
WHERE rnk <= 5

SELECT t1."AvgScrWrite", t2."City"
FROM california_schools."satscores" t1
JOIN california_schools."schools" t2 ON t1."cds" = t2."CDSCode"
WHERE t1."NumGE1500" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY t1."NumGE1500" DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT "AvgScrMath", "cname" FROM california_schools."satscores" WHERE "AvgScrMath" IS NOT NULL AND "AvgScrRead" IS NOT NULL AND "AvgScrWrite" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "AvgScrMath" + "AvgScrRead" + "AvgScrWrite" ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT s."School", sa."AvgScrWrite" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" sa ON s."CDSCode" = sa."cds" WHERE s."AdmFName1" = 'Ricci'

SELECT s."School" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE s.doc = '31' ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN doc = '54' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN doc = '52' THEN 1 END) FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "County" = 'Orange' AND "StatusType" = 'Merged'
SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "County" = 'Alameda' AND doc = '52' AND "OpenDate" LIKE '%1980%'

SELECT s."MailStreet", s."School" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" sa ON s."CDSCode" = sa."cds" WHERE sa."AvgScrMath" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sa."AvgScrMath" DESC OFFSET 6 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT t1."MailStreet", t1."School" FROM california_schools."schools" t1 JOIN california_schools."satscores" t2 ON t1."CDSCode" = t2."cds" WHERE t2."AvgScrRead" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t2."AvgScrRead" ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" sa ON s."CDSCode" = sa."cds" WHERE s."MailCity" = 'Lakeport' AND (sa."AvgScrRead" + sa."AvgScrMath" + sa."AvgScrWrite") >= 1500

SELECT "School", "ClosedDate"
FROM california_schools."schools"
WHERE "County" = (
  SELECT "County"
  FROM california_schools."schools"
  WHERE "StatusType" = 'Closed'
  GROUP BY "County"
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
)
AND "StatusType" = 'Closed'
SELECT SUM(t."NumTstTakr") FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" t ON s."CDSCode" = t."cds" WHERE s."MailCity" = 'Fresno'
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN "County" = 'Colusa' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN "County" = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 END) FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "MailState" = 'CA'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "MailState" = 'CA' AND "City" = 'San Joaquin' AND "StatusType" = 'Active'
SELECT "School", "Phone", "Ext" FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "Zip" = '95203-3704'

SELECT sc."Phone", sc."Ext" FROM california_schools."schools" sc JOIN california_schools."satscores" s ON sc."CDSCode" = s."cds" WHERE s."AvgScrWrite" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s."AvgScrWrite" DESC OFFSET 332 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT "School", "MailZip" FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "AdmFName1" = 'Avetik'
SELECT "Website" FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "County" = 'San Joaquin' AND "Charter" = 1 AND "Virtual" = 'P'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "Charter" = 1 AND "City" = 'Hickman' AND doc = '52'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE s."County" = 'Los Angeles' AND s."Charter" = 0 AND (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100 / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0)) < 0.18

SELECT "Website"
FROM california_schools."schools"
WHERE ("AdmFName1" = 'Mike' AND "AdmLName1" = 'Larson')
   OR ("AdmFName1" = 'Dante' AND "AdmLName1" = 'Alvarez')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "MailCity" = 'Hickman' AND "CharterNum" = '00D4'
SELECT "AdmFName1", "AdmLName1", "School", "City" FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "Charter" = 1 AND "CharterNum" = '00D2'
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN "FundingType" = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "County" = 'Santa Clara' AND "FundingType" IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "City" = 'San Francisco' AND "DOCType" = 'Community College District' AND "ClosedDate" LIKE '%1989%'
SELECT "NCESDist" FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE soc = '31'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "FundingType" = 'Directly Funded' AND "County" = 'Stanislaus' AND "OpenDate" BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'

SELECT "County"
FROM california_schools."schools"
WHERE soc = '11'
  AND SUBSTR("ClosedDate", 1, 4) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
GROUP BY "County"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "County" = 'Alpine' AND "StatusType" IN ('Active', 'Closed') AND "SOCType" = 'District Community Day Schools'

SELECT SUM(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM california_schools."frpm" f JOIN california_schools."schools" s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode" WHERE s."City" = 'Fremont' AND s."EdOpsCode" = 'SSS' AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" FROM california_schools."frpm" f JOIN california_schools."schools" s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode" WHERE s."MailStreet" = 'PO Box 1040' AND (s."EdOpsName" = 'Youth Authority School' OR s."EdOpsCode" = 'YTH')
SELECT DISTINCT t2."District Code" FROM california_schools."schools" t1 JOIN california_schools."frpm" t2 ON t1."CDSCode" = t2."CDSCode" WHERE t1."City" = 'Fresno' AND t1."Magnet" = 0

SELECT DISTINCT s."City" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE s."County" = 'Merced' AND s."EILCode" = 'HS' AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2' AND f."Low Grade" = '9' AND f."High Grade" = '12'

SELECT s."EILName", s."School" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE f."County Code" = '37' AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2'
SELECT "GSserved" FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "City" = 'Adelanto' AND "GSserved" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "GSserved" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT "County", COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "County" IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara') AND "Virtual" = 'F' GROUP BY "County" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT "SOCType", "School", "Latitude" FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "Latitude" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "Latitude" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT f."Low Grade" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE s."NCESDist" = '0613360' AND s."EdOpsCode" = 'SPECON'

SELECT s."School", (f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") * 100 FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE s."County" = 'Los Angeles' AND s."GSserved" = 'K-9'
SELECT "GSoffered" FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "Longitude" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ABS("Longitude") DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM california_schools."schools" t1 JOIN california_schools."frpm" t2 ON t1."CDSCode" = t2."CDSCode" WHERE t1."Magnet" = 1 AND t1."GSserved" = 'K-8' AND t2."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'

SELECT "AdmFName1", "District"
FROM california_schools."schools"
WHERE "AdmFName1" IN (
  SELECT "AdmFName1"
  FROM california_schools."schools"
  WHERE "AdmFName1" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY "AdmFName1"
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS ONLY
)

SELECT s."City", f."Low Grade", s."School" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode" WHERE s."State" = 'CA' ORDER BY s."Latitude" ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)", f."District Code" FROM california_schools."frpm" f JOIN california_schools."schools" s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode" WHERE s."AdmFName1" = 'Alusine'
SELECT "AdmLName1", "District", "County", "School" FROM california_schools."schools" WHERE "CharterNum" = '0040' OR "CharterNum" = '40'
SELECT COUNT(a."account_id") FROM financial."account" a JOIN financial."district" d ON a."district_id" = d."district_id" WHERE a."frequency" = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND LOWER(d.a3) = 'east bohemia'

SELECT COUNT(a."account_id") FROM financial."account" a JOIN financial."district" d ON a."district_id" = d."district_id" JOIN financial."disp" dp ON a."account_id" = dp."account_id" WHERE d.a3 = 'Prague' AND dp."type" = 'OWNER'

SELECT s."AdmEmail1", s."School" FROM california_schools."schools" s JOIN california_schools."satscores" sat ON s."CDSCode" = sat."cds" WHERE sat."NumGE1500" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sat."NumGE1500" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(a12) > AVG(a13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END FROM financial."district"
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1."district_id") FROM financial."district" t1 JOIN financial."client" t2 ON t1."district_id" = t2."district_id" WHERE t1.a11 > 6000 AND t1.a11 < 10000 AND t2."gender" = 'F'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM financial."client" c JOIN financial."district" d ON c."district_id" = d."district_id" WHERE c."gender" = 'M' AND LOWER(d.a3) = 'north bohemia' AND d.a11 > 8000

SELECT T1."account_id"
FROM financial."account" T1
JOIN financial."disp" T2 ON T1."account_id" = T2."account_id"
JOIN financial."client" T3 ON T2."client_id" = T3."client_id"
JOIN financial."district" T4 ON T3."district_id" = T4."district_id"
ORDER BY T3."birth_date" DESC, T4.a11 DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT t2."account_id", (SELECT MAX(a11) FROM financial."district") - t3.a11 FROM financial."client" t1 JOIN financial."disp" t2 ON t1."client_id" = t2."client_id" JOIN financial."district" t3 ON t1."district_id" = t3."district_id" WHERE t1."gender" = 'F' ORDER BY t1."birth_date" ASC, t3.a11 ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM financial."account" a JOIN financial."disp" d ON a."account_id" = d."account_id" WHERE a."frequency" = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND d."type" = 'OWNER'

SELECT s."AdmEmail1" FROM california_schools."schools" s WHERE s."County" = 'San Bernardino' AND s."District" = 'San Bernardino City Unified' AND s.soc = '62' AND s.doc = '54' AND s."OpenDate" BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND s."AdmEmail1" IS NOT NULL
SELECT d."client_id" FROM financial."disp" d JOIN financial."account" a ON d."account_id" = a."account_id" WHERE a."frequency" = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND d."type" = 'DISPONENT'

SELECT a."account_id" FROM financial."account" a JOIN financial."loan" l ON a."account_id" = l."account_id" WHERE l."duration" > 12 AND (a."date" LIKE '93%' OR a."date" LIKE '1993%') ORDER BY l."amount" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT a."account_id"
FROM financial."account" a
JOIN financial."loan" l ON a."account_id" = l."account_id"
WHERE (l."date" LIKE '97%' OR l."date" LIKE '1997%')
  AND a."frequency" = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
ORDER BY l."amount" ASC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT DISTINCT "account_id" FROM financial."trans" WHERE "date" = (SELECT MIN("date") FROM financial."trans" WHERE "date" LIKE '95%')

SELECT COUNT(t1."client_id") FROM financial."client" t1 JOIN financial."district" t2 ON t1."district_id" = t2."district_id" JOIN financial."disp" t3 ON t1."client_id" = t3."client_id" JOIN financial."account" t4 ON t3."account_id" = t4."account_id" WHERE t1."gender" = 'F' AND t2.a2 = 'Sokolov' AND SUBSTR(t1."birth_date", 1, 4) < '1950'
SELECT DISTINCT t1."account_id" FROM financial."account" t1 JOIN financial."trans" t2 ON t1."account_id" = t2."account_id" WHERE t1."date" < '970101' AND t2."amount" > 3000
SELECT d."client_id" FROM financial."card" c JOIN financial."disp" d ON c."disp_id" = d."disp_id" WHERE c."issued" LIKE '940303%'
SELECT a."date" FROM financial."account" a JOIN financial."trans" t ON a."account_id" = t."account_id" WHERE t."amount" = 840 AND t."date" = '981014'

SELECT MAX(t."amount")
FROM financial."card" c
JOIN financial."disp" d ON c."disp_id" = d."disp_id"
JOIN financial."trans" t ON d."account_id" = t."account_id"
WHERE c."issued" LIKE '961021%'

JOIN formula_1."races" t3 ON t1."raceId" = t3."raceId"
WHERE t2."forename" = 'Lewis'
  AND t2."surname" = 'Hamilton'
  AND t3."name" = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
SELECT SUM("wins") FROM formula_1."driverStandings" GROUP BY "driverId" ORDER BY SUM("points") DESC OFFSET 90 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT SUM(t1."points"), t2."name", t2."nationality" FROM formula_1."constructorResults" t1 JOIN formula_1."constructors" t2 ON t1."constructorId" = t2."constructorId" JOIN formula_1."races" t3 ON t1."raceId" = t3."raceId" WHERE t3."name" = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND t3."year" BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY t2."name", t2."nationality" ORDER BY SUM(t1."points") DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT c."name", c."location", c."country" FROM formula_1."circuits" c JOIN formula_1."races" r ON c."circuitId" = r."circuitId" WHERE r."date" = (SELECT MAX("date") FROM formula_1."races")

SELECT r."name"
FROM formula_1."races" r
JOIN formula_1."results" res ON r."raceId" = res."raceId"
WHERE res."fastestLapTime" = (SELECT MIN("fastestLapTime") FROM formula_1."results")

SELECT d."forename", d."surname" FROM formula_1."drivers" d JOIN formula_1."qualifying" q ON d."driverId" = q."driverId" JOIN formula_1."races" r ON q."raceId" = r."raceId" JOIN formula_1."circuits" c ON r."circuitId" = c."circuitId" WHERE c."name" = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND r."year" = 2008 ORDER BY TO_CHAR(q."q3") ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM formula_1."results" r JOIN formula_1."races" ra ON r."raceId" = ra."raceId" WHERE ra."name" = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r."statusId" = 3 GROUP BY r."driverId" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT MAX("duration") FROM formula_1."pitStops"

SELECT d."forename" || ' ' || d."surname" AS "full_name", d."nationality", r."name"
FROM formula_1."drivers" d
JOIN formula_1."results" res ON d."driverId" = res."driverId"
JOIN formula_1."races" r ON res."raceId" = r."raceId"
WHERE d."dob" = (SELECT MAX("dob") FROM formula_1."drivers")

FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT "time" FROM formula_1."lapTimes" WHERE "milliseconds" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "milliseconds" FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(r."resultId"), d."forename", d."surname" FROM formula_1."drivers" d LEFT JOIN formula_1."results" r ON d."driverId" = r."driverId" AND r."position" = 1 WHERE d."dob" = (SELECT MIN("dob") FROM formula_1."drivers") GROUP BY d."forename", d."surname"
